description: In every equality structure with at least two elements, the proposed constant graph \(y=y\) is total and fails uniqueness.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.DefinitionalExtensions.true_graph_total_not_unique.{u_1} {M : Type u_1} [Nontrivial M]
  [FirstOrder.Language.empty.Structure M] :
  (∀ (x : Fin 0 → M),
      ∃ y,
        ((Lemmatheca.Entry.DefinitionalExtensions.constantPackage true).functionGraph { down := ⋯ }).Realize
          (Sum.elim x fun x => y)) ∧
    ¬M ⊨
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.totalUnique
          ((Lemmatheca.Entry.DefinitionalExtensions.constantPackage true).functionGraph { down := ⋯ })
